semantic.justification: Task76 in progress: original clipboard ResetClip/InitClipPtrs and SharePooledResources retain genuine pool/string/attribute helper identities,source option values and sparse selected-sheet indexes. Clear releases actual formula and attribute owners before sheet removal. Native column4 CloneFormulaCell creates shared code once per shareable span,bulk-inserts actual typed storage and joins boundaries. Default CONTENTS CopyFromClipContext retains native cursor caches,cell values,metadata and deferred listening spans;single-cell column replication handles represented values,strings,empty and grouped formulas. Original temporary/inserting document guards suppress premature subscriptions and broadcasts. No browser fill loop,formula-text reparse,alternate workbook or simulated physical refcount is introduced. Document-level paste/reference completion,real paste undo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance are still pending;this progress record does not certify task76 or full native parity.
